subject.title: fix(browser): keep CDP discovery on the configured host

question: Should this PR's configured-host CDP control policy be accepted as the approved browser SSRF boundary for discovery, Playwright, and permission routes?
rationale: The patch looks correct and well-proven, but it intentionally changes where browser CDP control traffic gets an exact-host exception, which is a maintainer-owned security-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept this CDP boundary
options.body: Land this PR once required checks are green, treating exact configured-host CDP control as separate from page navigation policy.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for a revision that limits the new control policy to fewer call sites if maintainers want a smaller boundary change.

options.title: Pause for broader SSRF policy
options.body: Pause this PR if the control-plane versus navigation-policy boundary should be settled in a wider browser SSRF design first.

recommendation.title: Accept this CDP boundary
recommendation.body: Land this PR once required checks are green, treating exact configured-host CDP control as separate from page navigation policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the helper/control-policy surface and is already tied to this maintainer-labeled follow-up branch.
